02

2.1 Primary logo

Anatomy of the logo

  1. 1 House line — a home drawn in a single orange stroke
  2. 2 Winding path — the line runs on as the road that brings buyers home
  3. 3 Orange ring — holds the logo together, like a seal of trust
  4. 4 LUCKY-CHIRU — the name, bold and condensed in Charcoal
  5. 5 PROPERTIES — in orange with a soft metallic gradient
  6. 6 Tagline — “Properties into Possibilities” in script, under a thin grey rule
123456

Always use the supplied file. Never redraw, recolour or rearrange it.

2.2 Logo system

One logo, four versions

The circle logo is the client’s own, rebuilt from a 150 px file: shapes traced, lettering set in Oswald Bold and Yesteryear. The other three versions are new — approve them before use.

1  Primary (circle)

The default. Posters, profile banners, brochures, boards.

2  Horizontal

Wide, short spaces. Website header, letterheads, cards.

3  House mark

When the name is already nearby. Watermarks, key tags, icons.

4  Badge

Profile picture, WhatsApp, reel corners, favicon.

2.3 Clear space and size

Give it room to breathe

Clear space on every side equals x, the height of the “L” in LUCKY-CHIRU. Keep text, photo edges and other logos out of it. Scale the logo as one piece.

xxxx

Primary

120 px · 30 mm

Horizontal

160 px · 40 mm

Badge

48 px · 12 mm

2.4 Logo on colour

White disc on any ground

The circle logo carries its own white disc, so it works on light, navy and photos. On orange the ring disappears: use the navy version there. The no-circle logo needs white, Cream or navy (reversed).

3.1 Primary colour

Lucky Orange

The colour of the house line and the ring. It marks the call to action, the price and the one thing buyers should notice. Charcoal text on it, always.

Matches the logo ring and the orange headlines on their posters. CMYK is converted from RGB, so ask the printer for a proof.

CMYK 0 50 87 5

3.2 Core palette

Orange for energy, navy and gold for luxury

All taken from their logo, posters and reels: orange headlines, navy price panels, gold “Luxury Living” lettering, beige backgrounds and yellow reel captions.

Tap any colour to copy its HEX code.

3.3 Tints

Tints for depth

Lighter steps for cards, fact boxes, maps and charts. Text and buttons always use the 100% colour.

3.4 Gradient

The sunset gradient

From the metallic PROPERTIES in the logo: Burnt Orange to light orange and back. For the logo word, one big headline or a premium price card only.

#E0640F#F9A55C

Flat orange for buttons

“Book your site visit” and “WhatsApp us” pills.

One per layout

A launch headline or a premium price card.

Never orange to navy

Keep the two brand colours flat and separate.

3.5 Colour rules

The 60–30–10 rule

60% light — white, Paper or beige, so photos and the logo breathe.

30% Night Navy — price panels, approval strips, dark posts and boards.

10% orange or gold — orange for everyday listings, gold for luxury — never both as the hero.

Section 06

Voice

  • 6.1Brand personality
  • 6.2Tone in practice

06

6.1 Brand personality

A trusted local builder, proud of every brick

Confident, warm and precise. Lets the building, the location and the approvals do the talking.

Friendly

Do: Speak to buyers like a neighbour showing them around.

Not: Hard-sell “last unit!!!” pressure.

Honest

Do: Give price, area and charges up front.

Not: “Call for price” on every post.

Local

Do: Name the area, the street and what’s 1 km away.

Not: Vague “prime location” claims.

Clear

Do: One property, one angle, one call to action.

Not: Five listings crammed into one post.

6.2 Tone in practice

How we write

Headline first (Luxury Living, Brand New Commercial Building), then locality, features, price and phone.

English and Kannada both welcome. One or two emoji per caption at most: 🏡 📍

Always Lucky-Chiru Properties, with the hyphen — never “Lucky Chiru Property”.

Write this

Everything close. Life made easy.

The right time creates the perfect address.

Book your site visit today. Contact: +91 79753 33672

Not this

BEST DEAL IN BANGALORE!!! HURRY!!!

Prime location, all amenities, call for price.

Guaranteed 20% returns, no risk.

7.1 Recent work

Posters that already work

Real Lucky-Chiru posts. New designs should feel like these: one bold headline, real photos or renders, a feature grid, then price and phone at the bottom.

7.2 Social posts

Post templates

Feed posts at 1080 × 1350. Logo at the top, one headline, one CTA. Bracketed values are placeholders.
